description:
Create a Pareto analysis of bloodstream infections using the Epi Info 7 Visual Dashboard.

Your goal is to identify the 'vital few' pathogens causing bloodstream infections.

1. Open the Visual Dashboard.
2. Load the dataset: 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\hospital_microbiology.csv'.
3. Apply a filter so the dashboard ONLY uses records where the 'Source' is 'Blood'.
4. Add a Pareto Chart gadget to analyze the 'Organism' field.
5. Save the chart as an image to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiAnalysis\bsi_pareto.png'.
6. Save the dashboard canvas as 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiAnalysis\bsi_dashboard.cvs7'.
